steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Roman entertainment served political purposes — panem et circenses (bread and circuses) kept the population content | Key Fact: Gladiatorial games (munera) originated as funeral rites and evolved into mass entertainment | Key Fact: The Colosseum (Flavian Amphitheatre) could hold 50,000-80,000 spectators and hosted gladiatorial combat and animal hunts | Key Fact: Gladiators were usually slaves, prisoners of war or condemned criminals — though some volunteered for fame and money
